note: Added to the free-floating list for ethnic groups: --Reparations (May Subd Geog).
Added to the free-floating list for animals: --Effect of forest management on and --Effect of logging on, both May Subd Geog.
Added to the free-floating pattern list for wars: --Participation, Communist (no geographic subdivision).

Chronological subdivisions under literature headings, other than free-floating ones, must be supported by research documenting the significance of the date. Albanian literature--To 1700 was not approved without that research; it may be resubmitted.
Arts, South American is not authorized for geographic subdivision; more specific regions or countries are expressed by headings such as Arts, Brazilian.

New free-floating --Internet marketing (May Subd Geog), used under types of commodities, products, and services, replacing a proposed heading for the Internet in wineries; Wine--Internet marketing may be assigned.

Added to the list for individual persons: --In opera and --On television. --On television is for works on television programming about the person (dramatic or documentary shows, news, advertising), not for the person as television actor, host, or news anchor.
The subdivision --Aftershocks under individual earthquakes was not approved. Use the name of the earthquake plus Earthquake aftershocks--[place] (May Subd Geog).
Added to the free-floating list for chemicals: --Vapor pressure (May Subd Geog).

War on Terrorism, 2001- is not a war in the conventional sense and is outside the scope of the H 1200 wars pattern list. Only specifically established subdivisions such as --Law and legislation and --Religious aspects may be used; other pattern subdivisions require a proposal. The same applies to September 11 Terrorist Attacks, 2001 and similar headings.
Added to the free-floating list for animals: --Effect of odors on and --Recolonization, both May Subd Geog.
Added to the free-floating list for plants: --Mulching (May Subd Geog).
Added to the free-floating list for animals: --Development--Endocrine aspects and --Larvae--Endocrinology.

When --Study and teaching is authorized for further geographic division, a geographic subdivision may not be placed between the heading and --Study and teaching. Chinese--Malaysia--Study and teaching was refused; use Chinese--Study and teaching--Malaysia, Chinese--Malaysia, and Malaysia--Study and teaching.

The multiple subdivisions --Methods (Jazz, [Rock, Bluegrass, etc.]) and --Studies and exercises (Jazz, [Rock, Bluegrass, etc.]) were cancelled and replaced by individual subdivisions under the pattern heading Piano. H 1161 is to be revised with a complete list of valid subdivisions.

Form subdivision --Audiocassette catalogs added to the free-floating lists for general subjects, ethnic groups, corporate bodies, individual persons, places, and musical compositions; --Audiotape catalogs was also added under musical compositions.
Added to the free-floating list for animals: --Effect of water acidification on (May Subd Geog).
Added to the free-floating list for materials: --Effect of lasers on (May Subd Geog).
Headings for classes of persons are not qualified by regional or national adjectives; that concept is expressed with geographic subdivision.
LC form subdivisions are often broad. The proposed subdivision --Graphic novels was not established; the broader --Comic books, strips, etc. covers graphic novels on specific topics.
--Teacher training is used only in the field of religious education. For teachers in other fields use --Training of under the heading for the class of teachers.
Added to the free-floating list for languages: --Conversation and phrase books (for fire fighters).

--Bowing added to the instrument list, and Violin added as a pattern heading in H 1161; subdivisions not suitable for Piano or Clarinet but appropriate for stringed instruments may be established under Violin.

patterns: [Type of building or structure]--Remodeling for other use
note: New free-floating --Remodeling for other use (May Subd Geog), used under types of buildings and structures.
New free-floating --Circulation, used under types of serial publications.
New free-floating --Electronic publishing (May Subd Geog), used under types of published materials and headings for literature on particular topics.
New free-floating form subdivision --Excerpts, used under motion picture forms and genres.
The usage note for --Newspapers on the H 1095 list was revised to read: use under subjects.
Added to the free-floating list for organs of the body: --Cross-sectional imaging (May Subd Geog).
--In art, --In literature, and --In motion pictures are free-floating under geographic headings tagged 151, so Polar regions in art and similar headings need not be established.

Headings of the type [disease] in [type of animal] are made only for conditions generally regarded as animal diseases. For conditions common to humans and animals, use [disease] in animals plus [type of animal]--Diseases, e.g. Obesity in animals with Horses--Diseases.

Because Zanzibar is part of Tanzania, literature of Zanzibar is expressed as Tanzanian literature--Tanzania--Zanzibar (and similarly for the English-language and wit and humor headings), not as a Zanzibari literature heading.
Added to the free-floating list for places: --Kings and rulers--Deposition.

Policy change: Caribbean islands south of the Virgin Islands are no longer assigned directly after subjects. Islands independent as countries (Dominica, Martinique) are assigned directly; islands that are part of a multi-island country (Bonaire, Curacao) are assigned indirectly through the country, e.g. Marine algae--Netherlands Antilles--Bonaire. Features on those islands are likewise indirect through the country. Qualifiers for such features use the larger jurisdiction, not the island.

Comic books or strips on a particular topic are expressed with free-floating --Comic books, strips, etc. after the topical heading, e.g. War--Comic books, strips, etc. Spy and War comic books headings were not approved; form headings for comic books stay limited to existing fictional genres.

Specific headings for conditions in groups of people exist only for general age and sex groups (children, women). For other groups assign the condition heading plus the group heading with a subdivision such as --Diseases or --Physiology, e.g. Weight loss with Nursing home patients--Diseases.

patterns: [Type of geographic area]--Effect of grazing on
note: --Effect of [...] on is not extended beyond existing patterns (plants, animals, materials, body parts, some business topics). Wetlands--Effect of grazing on was refused; assign Grazing--Environmental aspects with the geographic area heading.

patterns: [Form heading for fictional genre]--Comic books, strips, etc.
note: LC does not use --Comic books, strips, etc. under form headings, and makes no distinction between fictional and nonfiction comic books and strips. UF references from Science fiction--Comic books, strips, etc. and similar strings were refused.
Subgenres of love stories based on character attributes were not approved. Love stories featuring a class of characters may get an added entry for the class of persons with --Fiction.
--Taxation--Law and legislation was authorized for free-floating use under topical headings (WL02-47), so Farm corporations--Taxation--Law and legislation needs no proposal.
Added to the free-floating list for materials: --Fires and fire prevention (May Subd Geog).

Electric violoncello with orchestra can be constructed without an authority record once Electric violoncello and Electric violoncello music exist. A music heading is required as a companion to a new instrument heading (H 1918).
The plural form peoples is not used in qualifiers for LCSH headings; Yawarawarga (Australian peoples) was changed to (Australian people).
Concertos (Maracas) and Concertos (Steel drum) can be constructed without subject authority records.
A subdivision --Antiquities, Armenian was not created; the concept is covered by free-floating Armenians--[place]--Antiquities and Armenia--Antiquities.
Headings of the type [place]--Flood, [date] were discontinued in 1985 in favor of Floods--[place]. Netherlands--Flood, 1570 was cancelled and Netherlands--Flood, 1953 was not approved.
Added to the free-floating list for places: --Kings and rulers--Assassination.
The free-floating subdivision --Sexual behavior now carries (May Subd Geog) on the lists for classes of persons, ethnic groups, and animals.
Added to the free-floating list for land vehicles: --Fluid capacities (May Subd Geog).

Subdivisions of the type --Effect of [concept] on are derivative: a heading for the concept must exist in LCSH before the subdivision is proposed, using the same terminology. Fishes--Effect of water currents on requires a heading for water currents first.
Added to the free-floating lists for individual schools and types of schools: --Professional staff.
Quotation headings are qualified by language but not by nationality (except American quotations). Quotations from the Philippines in English are expressed as Quotations, English--Philippines.

Headings for fictitious characters take only subdivisions widely used under topical headings, such as --Exhibitions or --Fiction, not subdivisions restricted to real persons or groups. Simpsons (Fictitious characters)--Homes and haunts was refused.
New free-floating --Simulation games, used under topical headings.
Form subdivision --Blogs added to the free-floating lists for general subjects, classes of persons, ethnic groups, and individual persons.
Form subdivision --Weblogs was deleted from the free-floating lists for general subjects, classes of persons, ethnic groups, and individual persons, replaced by --Blogs.
Added --Deterioration (May Subd Geog) to the free-floating lists for general subjects and materials.

--Geographical distribution is used only under entities not in fixed locations, such as plants and animals, not under immovable geographic features. Wetlands--Geographical distribution was refused; use Wetlands--[place].
